source_locator.edition_or_translation: J. M. Ashmand translation from Proclus's Greek paraphrase; 1900 W. Foulsham & Co. new edition
source_locator.short_quote: six are called masculine and diurnal, and six feminine and nocturnal ... arranged in alternate order

calculation_dependencies: sign position in the source's alternating sequence
normalized_rule: Under the Aries-origin alternating arrangement, classify Taurus, Cancer, Virgo, Scorpio, Capricorn, and Pisces as feminine and nocturnal signs.
synthesis_notes: This is a source-specific sign-gender taxonomy, not a claim about human gender or scientific compatibility.
review_notes: This rule is limited to the Aries-origin alternating arrangement. Chapter XV also reports Ascendant/Moon-relative and horizon-quadrant alternatives; none is selected here.
transmission_notes: The main-text Aries-origin arrangement is recorded separately from the alternative arrangements explicitly reported later in Chapter XV. Chapter XVI's same/different-kind configuration language is not reconciled with this sequence; see CONFLICT-PTOLEMY-SIGN-KIND-001. The source-era labels are not modern identity claims.
